name: Hamlet: Dongbang-ui Wangja
source:
To be or not to be, that is the question! What will you choose?

Hamlet: Prince of the East is a story-based game adapted from the classic play Hamlet by William Shakespeare.
Follow Prince Hamlet’s emotional journey of revenge, now reimagined in a beautifully stylized East Asian setting.
Will Hamlet seek justice? Forgive his family? Choose love? Run away?
Your decisions will shape his fate.

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hamlet-prince-of-the-east/id6747997116]App Store[/url]]
